title: BIOLOG mutable aggregate envelope
description: ADR-0001 Decision 3.1. Fields every mutable tenant aggregate carries. Immutable and append-only records must NOT carry version (Decision 3.3).

tenant_id.description: Owning tenant. Every tenant-plane read and write is filtered by the resolved tenant context, never by this field alone.

version.description: Optimistic concurrency token. Starts at 1, +1 per committed mutation. Opaque to clients.
